chunk.content: The yellow drum (Nibea albiflora) shares similar external characteristics, meat quality and flavour with the large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea).
chunk.source_quote: Yellow drum shares similar external characteristics, meat quality and flavors with large yellow croaker.

source.title: Near-complete genome assembly and annotation of the yellow drum (Nibea albiflora) provide insights into population and evolutionary characteristics of this species (Ecology and Evolution; doi:10.1002/ece3.4778)
